description: presence.rs line 177: obj.insert("updatedAt".to_string(), json\!(now_utc_string())). Calling .to_string() on a &'static str literal routes through the Display/ToString path unnecessarily. Clippy::str-to-string flags this. Should be "updatedAt".to_owned() or String::from("updatedAt").
title: presence.rs: .to_string() on string literal should be .to_owned()
